# MR Simple Dart: An Innovative Mixed Reality Darts Experience
MR Simple Dart is a unique mixed reality darts game designed for Meta Quest. It combines virtual dartboards with your real environment, allowing players to enjoy darts anywhere—indoors, on a balcony, or even on a rooftop. This game is perfect for those seeking relaxation and fun.
